lcc_original: 上帝說：『水要滋生無數的活物，要有飛鳥飛在地上，天穹之中。』
notes: 活物 receives three SNs (H5315 nephesh + H2416 chayyah + H8318 sherets) — LCC combines what UNV splits across 有生命的物 into a single compound
無數的 left unannotated — LCC's own rendering of the abundance/swarming concept; no separate Hebrew word maps to it
天穹 treated as compound receiving H8064 (shamayim) + H7549 (raqia), parallel to UNV's 天空
飛鳥 is a compound noun (bird, H5775); the following 飛 is the verb (fly, H5774+WTH8787)
